prompt: Create a website for synth enthusiasts
summary: A static brochure/community site for synth enthusiasts covering vintage and modern synthesizers, a browsable gear catalog, patch tips, and event listings. Everything is read-only reference content (no accounts, orders, or server-side data changes), so a single static site fully serves the prompt with in-browser filtering for the gear catalog.

services.name: synthwave-collective
services.buildCommand: mkdir -p dist && cp -r src/*.html src/*.css src/*.js dist/ && cp -r assets dist/assets
